issues: No integrity problems. The diff adds a dual_annealing search over the 52 centre coordinates, scored by the existing _score LP. It reads no files, pastes no coordinates and uses no labels.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. Once the deadline passes, obj returns 0.0 and the callback stops the run. The deadline is min(T0+205s, now+120s), so the job should stay within the 5-minute limit. _relax, _slsqp_refine and _make_valid still run after the deadline, but they should be short.

Minor: when the annealed centres win straight from _score (the rv_d branch), those radii skip _make_valid. This is presumably safe because the later incumbent pipeline still runs and the run did not crash.

The candidate gives -2.636 on a single run, the same as the incumbent mean of -2.6360 over a single run. The difference is about zero (to the reported precision), so the new stage gained nothing within its time budget. The z of -0.000 and the provisional reject are consistent. With n=1 on each side the variance cannot really be estimated, so z is only meaningful as 'no difference'.
A reported 2.636 is slightly above the best-known 2.635. This is presumably rounding (about 2.6359) and is the same for the incumbent, so it does not count as a mismatched claim.
